name: member signs in through the sign-in page
member review is created and a receipt page is shown
My reviews lists the new review with a "Waiting for moderation" chip
a pending review offers Edit and Withdraw (and no Appeal)
the status chip has text, not only colour
edit form opens prefilled with the review
Save is disabled until something changes
a too-short note is refused on the page with an inline error
Save turns on after a change
the PATCH sent only the version and the changed title
after saving, the detail page shows "Saved as version 2" and two versions in the history
a second writer can save first (version 2 to 3)
a stale save shows the conflict message, keeps the typed text and offers Reload
Reload brings in the latest version (tab B title)
moderator signs in to the staff app with password and TOTP
the decision list offers "Ask for changes" next to Publish and Reject
the author now sees "Changes requested" on the list
the detail page shows the moderator's reason
the edit form is still available and repeats the reason
after editing, the review is waiting for moderation again
a published review has no Edit button but can be withdrawn
opening the edit URL of a published review shows "can no longer be edited"
the published review appears on the public destination page
the public review list shows a filter bar
filtering to 1 star hides a 4-star review and explains why
clearing the rating filter brings it back
the "Guests" author filter hides a member review
the first page shows 20 reviews and a "Show more" button (23 bulk reviews added)
loading more appends the rest with no duplicates
at the end the list says "That is all your reviews."
the status filter resets to page 1 and shows only that status
a filter with no match shows the empty message
the destination filter narrows the list to that destination only
Withdraw asks for confirmation first
Cancel leaves the review untouched
confirming withdraws it, shows the notice and the card turns "Withdrawn"
withdrawing again is accepted (idempotent retry)
signed out, My reviews shows a sign-in prompt, not a blank page
the review detail API refuses a signed-out caller (401)
an unknown review id answers 404
the page for an unknown review says "not found"
offline, a filter change shows an error with Retry (and no stale list)
back online, Retry reloads the list
at 360 px wide there is no horizontal scroll
every card control is at least 40 px tall (tap targets)
in Bangla the page heading is in Bangla
every form control on My reviews has a label
a guest review is created and shows the receipt once
the receipt is not kept in browser storage or the URL
the receipt status panel shows "Waiting for moderation" with Edit and Withdraw
the guest edit form starts empty and says to fill in only what changes
Save is off until the guest changes something
the guest PATCH carries the receipt in the body, only the title as content, and no cookie
after a rejection the receipt shows the reason and the appeal deadline
a rejected review no longer offers Edit
Send appeal stays off below 20 characters and the counter says so
the appeal is sent with the receipt in the body only, and the page says "Appeal sent"
the status now shows "Appeal received" and no second appeal is offered
the owner API view lists the version history and hides moderator-only fields
